passages.note: Enrolled act amending IC 16-34-2-1: abortion is a criminal act except for serious health risk to or to save the life of the mother, a lethal fetal anomaly (before viability/20 weeks), and pregnancies from rape or incest (first 10 weeks).
IGA bill details/digest page for SB 1(ss); authored by Sen. Glick, does not mention Garten or his vote.

rows.reasoning: Garten voted Yea on SB 1(ss) (2022 First Special Session) (Roll Call 58, Aug 5 2022), which amended IC 16-34-2-1 to make abortion 'a criminal act' except where the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest, or there is a serious health risk to or risk to the life of the mother. This matches the rung that would 'ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life,' and excludes the no-exceptions rung and the first-trimester-allowance rung.
